Construct a sources table for a multidimensional VRT

Source: R/vrtstack-core.R
mdim_sources.Rd

One row per output step along the concat (time) axis. This is the interface contract produced by adapters and consumed by emit_mdim_vrt().

Usage

mdim_sources(
  time,
  dsn,
  source_ref,
  kind,
  step_in_file = 0L,
  dest_index = NULL,
  source_view = NA_character_
)

Arguments

time

Vector of per-step coordinate values (e.g. a Date vector).

dsn

Source data source names (file paths or /vsicurl/ URIs).

source_ref

Array path (e.g. "/sst") when kind = "array", or band number (e.g. "1") when kind = "band".

kind

Source flavour: "array" (<SourceArray>, a multidimensional source) or "band" (<SourceBand>, a classic 2D source).

step_in_file

Zero-based step index within a multi-step file.

dest_index

Zero-based destination position along the concat axis; defaults to the rank order of time.

source_view

Optional GetView expression that brings each source to exactly the destination rank (e.g. "[newaxis,...]" to rank a 2D band up to a 3D cube, "[:,0,:,:]" to drop a singleton dimension). NA for none.

Value

A data frame ordered by dest_index, one row per output step.

See also

mdim_signature(), emit_mdim_vrt()
